platform.owner: Exclusive single SDL main-thread owner. Actual Context, product Config, ConsoleVariable, ThreadPool, ResourceManager, Console, guarded Fast3dGui, Fast3dWindow, optional actual LUS ControlDeck and UltraBridge. No extra qualification window or hidden backend retry is created.
platform.product_data: SDL_GetPrefPath(35mmIsle,35mmIsle), or an explicit native filesystem directory; actual persistent 35mmIsle.json plus owned ImGui ini/log paths. Normal pinned LUS Config/CVar/window persistence is used; no null-backed config, export mirror, process-CWD changes or 8.3 aliases.
platform.Windows_paths: Every native path crossing the pinned LUS narrow stream/archive boundary is explicitly encoded using path.u8string(). Windows requires GetACP()==CP_UTF8 before acquisition. Actual executable must embed activeCodePage=UTF-8; parent owns that fusion-manifest/CMake integration. SDL UTF8 preference paths and renderer-resource literals enter native filesystem paths with u8path. No locale-dependent path.string() conversion.
platform.Windows_authority: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/apps/design/globalizing/use-utf8-code-page (read2026-10-16): process UTF8 fusion manifest supported1903+, CP_ACP==CP_UTF8 with manifest; Windows11 target exceeds this floor. No Windows runtime execution is claimed.
platform.Windows_header_order: Define existing WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN/NOMINMAX and include windows.h before any native/LUS/SDL/vendor header. On611b9da the guards appeared after vendor includes, allowing Windows min/max macros to corrupt std::min/std::max expressions; MSVC host CI diagnosed the failure. The reordered boundary preserves the actual clipping math and uses no compiler-warning suppression or legacy API fallback. Published d2231a5 passed GitHub Actions38877723690: MSVC Debug/Release, standalone canonical RDP and full static LUS/audio/RSP/RDP/native-engine host build. No Windows11 ROM runtime claim.
platform.partial_acquisition: Required existing exact-pin lifetime adaptation guards interpreter/window teardown. GUI platform/renderer shutdown is gated on actual acquired ImGui backend data. SDL partial initialization is balanced; all controller backreferences, bridge caches, GUI windows, resources and worker owners are released. First operational failure remains immutable through cleanup.

input.normal: Real ControlDeck Init and WriteToPad. All four logical source ports carry the actual LUS controller-bit mask, actual OSContPad.err_no/buttons/sticks and actual acquired Controller owner pointer identity. LUS aggregates keyboard/mouse/gamepads, so the pointer identifies that real logical acquisition owner, not a fabricated physical SDL instance or port+1. No invented physical gamepad identity is claimed.
input.blocked_or_failed: Two fixed alternate pad destinations detect WriteToPad returning before an actual read when all input is blocked: GetPads must identify the current destination. Exception or actual SDL-reported read error gives completed=false and retained fatal message; caller must not complete/acknowledge an input request. Actual per-port err_no is propagated. Host never calls Service.begin_update or publishes/acknowledges a Service token itself.
input.diagnostic_disabled: Explicit Config.input=diagnostic_disabled. SDL_INIT_GAMEPAD omitted, no ControlDeck constructed/initialized, keyboard/mouse acquisition callback event types disabled, ImGui SDL3 set to Manual gamepad mode with an empty device set before first NewFrame. Returns a completed all-ABSENT frame with identity0 and controller_bits0, never a synthetic connected controller. Does not qualify hardware.

presentation.input: One completed tightly packed320x240 RGBA8 const byte span, stride1280, plus live ScreenOffsets. Compatible with startup::graphics::Completed.rgba/screen_offsets. Source span is needed only during queue_present; no native/RAM/preparation borrow survives the synchronous copy.
presentation.ownership: One alignas64 preallocated307200-byte tile store and2048 preallocated native GBI commands.75 independent64x16 RGBA32 tiles, point/clamp one-cycle DECALRGBA and opaque surface rendering; never RGBA32 COPY. No per-frame vector/PCM/command allocation or host-frame copy queue. Black VI-exterior clear and clipped texture coordinates preserve half-pixel horizontal and source-rounded vertical translations.
presentation.backpressure: Actual DrawAndRunGraphicsCommands false retains exactly the copied bytes and commands until real success or explicit cancel. queue_present cannot overwrite a pending frame. Presentation does not acquire input, notify retrace, tick a scene or produce audio.
presentation.fence: Actual glFinish after successful draw, before texture address reuse/cache deletion and before final cache clear/window destruction. LUS OpenGL FinishRender is not treated as a GPU fence. Caller separately fences/retire actual canonical graphics RSP/RDP/CPU readback before the next Runtime.tick. Host owns copied pixels, not that mandatory graphics lease.

audio.initialization: Checked SdlAudioOutput at native S16 stereo32006 with bounded source queue (default4096, must hold maximum1024-frame source block), exact selected physical endpoint/no driver or device fallback. game_audio::hydrate plus native_startup_effects creates the actual default8-section graph and real Session. No manually asserted ready flag or Null consumer.
audio.executor: Session initialize installs validated admitted GAME main ROM0x1000..0x46270 to RAM0x400, clears only source BSS0x45670..0x9a8c0, installs actual boot at0x107000 and constructs a real rsp::Machine borrowing that exact stable AudioService RAM. Session creation verifies the actual borrower. Snapshot is borrowed only during create; owned256-byte canonical boot survives. No whole-RAM replacement/copy.
audio.task: Public numeric audio type2/flags0 task, boot0x107000/0x100, text0x3d980/0x1000, data0x44ba0/0x800, actual published command address/count, unused fields zero. Bounded10000000 block-entry execution; actual SP0x203, zero packets/packet_words/full_syncs required. Unexpected DPC rejects the task. Every published token gets actual success/failure/cancellation completion even on exceptions or post-build errors.
audio.output: Required callbacks adapt existing SdlAudioOutput inspect, try_submit, finish_input, poll_drain. Accepted reports the whole synchronously SDL-owned prefix; WouldBlock reports0 and retains the exact Session PCM/scratch lease. No extra PCM buffer, conversion or copy is added. Fatal endpoint message wins before subsequent cleanup calls.
audio.clock: notify_retrace(ordinal,monotonic_ns) is independent of events/presentation. pump_audio performs at most one real RSP task and nonblocking copy submission. Session owns native AI ledger/fractional carry/one-message coalescing; SDL queue bytes are never guest AI. Caller must serialize every graphics/audio RSP execution because RSP internals are globally serialized.
audio.stop: stop_audio requests real client release, then caller continues actual independent retraces and pump_audio until Session drains. poll_audio_drain observes only checked flushed SDL input/output exhaustion, not DAC/hearing completion. shutdown destroys completed PCM ownership, retires Machine before Session service RAM, closes actual stream/watch before LUS/backend SDL lifetime ends. Pending output is explicitly CloseDisposition::aborted, never fabricated drained.
